metadata.name: THMD-Guru LAB KB: OWASP Top 10 2021, CWE, CVSS v3.1, OWASP WSTG v4.2 verification rules
metadata.note: tp_signals / fp_signals are machine-checkable regex rules applied to real ZAP evidence, request and response. Text fields are injected into the LLM prompt as RAG context and cited in reports.

entries.name: SQL Injection
tp_indicators: Database driver error text (SQLITE_ERROR, You have an error in your SQL syntax, ORA-, PG::SyntaxError) appears only with the injected payload
Boolean/time-based difference confirmed between true and false payloads
Authentication bypass returns a valid session or JWT
fp_exclusion_rules: Generic HTTP 500 caused by type parsing (invalid integer, JSON parse) without any SQL driver trace
Identical error page returned for any malformed input regardless of quote balance

fp_signals.regex: invalid (integer|input syntax for integer)|Unexpected token .* in JSON|NaN

entries.remediation: Use parameterized queries / bound ORM parameters; never concatenate user input into SQL.
sources: OWASP WSTG v4.2 WSTG-INPV-05 Testing for SQL Injection

entries.name: Cross-Site Scripting (Reflected / Stored / DOM)
tp_indicators: Payload reflected unescaped inside a text/html response in an executable context
DOM sink (innerHTML, bypassSecurityTrustHtml, document.write) receives attacker-controlled data
fp_exclusion_rules: Payload reflected inside application/json with X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff

tp_signals.desc: Attack string reflected verbatim in text/html

entries.remediation: Context-aware output encoding, avoid unsafe DOM sinks, strict Content-Security-Policy.
sources: OWASP WSTG v4.2 WSTG-INPV-01 Testing for Reflected XSS

entries.name: Path Traversal
tp_indicators: Response contains content of a file outside the web root (/etc/passwd root:x:0:0, win.ini [fonts])
fp_exclusion_rules: SPA fallback returns index.html with HTTP 200 for any path
entries.remediation: Canonicalize paths and enforce an allowlist of accessible files.
sources: OWASP WSTG v4.2 WSTG-ATHZ-01 Testing Directory Traversal File Include

entries.name: OS Command Injection
tp_indicators: Output of injected OS command (uid=, root:x:0:0, directory listing) in response
fp_exclusion_rules: Response time variance without consistent correlation to injected delay
entries.remediation: Avoid shell invocation; use safe APIs with argument arrays and strict input validation.
sources: OWASP WSTG v4.2 WSTG-INPV-12 Testing for Command Injection

entries.name: Cross-Site Request Forgery / Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens
tp_indicators: State-changing form (POST) authenticated by cookie without anti-CSRF token or SameSite protection
fp_exclusion_rules: Search or login forms that do not change server state
APIs authenticated by Authorization: Bearer header instead of cookies
entries.remediation: Synchronizer token or double-submit cookie; SameSite=Lax/Strict cookies.
sources: OWASP WSTG v4.2 WSTG-SESS-05 Testing for CSRF

entries.name: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR)
tp_indicators: HTTP 200 with another user's private object when the identifier is changed
fp_exclusion_rules: Public catalog/product endpoints intended for unauthenticated reads
entries.remediation: Server-side ownership check on every object access.
sources: OWASP WSTG v4.2 WSTG-ATHZ-04 Testing for IDOR

entries.name: Server-Side Request Forgery
tp_indicators: Content from loopback, link-local metadata (169.254.169.254) or internal subnet returned to client
fp_exclusion_rules: Client-side redirect where the server never performs the outbound request
entries.remediation: Allowlist outbound destinations; block RFC1918, loopback and link-local ranges.
sources: OWASP WSTG v4.2 WSTG-INPV-19 Testing for SSRF

entries.name: Application Error Disclosure / Stack Trace
tp_indicators: Stack trace with file paths, framework versions or SQL fragments returned to client
fp_exclusion_rules: Generic friendly error page without internal details

tp_signals.regex: at [\w.$]+\(.*:\d+:\d+\)|Traceback \(most recent call last\)|/var/www/|node_modules/|Exception in thread

entries.remediation: Disable verbose errors in production; log details server-side only.
sources: OWASP WSTG v4.2 WSTG-ERRH-01 Testing for Improper Error Handling

entries.name: Exposure of Sensitive Information (backup files, directories)
tp_indicators: Backup/config file (.bak, .env, .git, package.json.bak, SQL dump) downloadable with real content
fp_exclusion_rules: SPA fallback returning index.html with HTTP 200 for non-existent backup names
entries.remediation: Remove backup files from web root, block dotfiles at reverse proxy, disable directory listing.
sources: OWASP WSTG v4.2 WSTG-CONF-04 Review Old Backup and Unreferenced Files

entries.name: Server Version / Timestamp Disclosure
tp_indicators: Exact server/framework version in Server or X-Powered-By header
fp_exclusion_rules: Unix timestamps in static JS bundles or ETags that are not server time
Generic Server header without version number
entries.remediation: Hide version banners (server_tokens off, expose_php Off, remove X-Powered-By).
sources: OWASP WSTG v4.2 WSTG-INFO-02 Fingerprint Web Server

entries.name: Suspicious Comments in Source
tp_indicators: Comment reveals credentials, internal hosts, TODO with security impact or hidden endpoints
fp_exclusion_rules: Framework/library license headers and minified bundle keywords (e.g. 'select', 'from', 'user' inside vendor JS)
entries.remediation: Strip comments in production builds; never store secrets in client code.
sources: OWASP WSTG v4.2 WSTG-INFO-05 Review Webpage Content for Information Leakage

entries.name: Missing Security Headers (CSP, X-Content-Type-Options)
tp_indicators: Interactive HTML document missing Content-Security-Policy / X-Content-Type-Options
fp_exclusion_rules: Static images, fonts, icons or redirects missing headers that only matter for HTML documents
entries.remediation: Set security headers globally at the reverse proxy for HTML responses.
sources: OWASP WSTG v4.2 WSTG-CONF-07 Test HTTP Strict Transport Security / headers

entries.name: Clickjacking (Missing X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors)
tp_indicators: Authenticated HTML page with state-changing actions can be framed
fp_exclusion_rules: Non-HTML resources (images, JSON, fonts) missing X-Frame-Options
sources: OWASP WSTG v4.2 WSTG-CLNT-09 Testing for Clickjacking

entries.name: Missing HSTS / Cleartext Transmission
fp_exclusion_rules: HSTS warning on a plain-HTTP-only lab service (HSTS only applies over HTTPS)
entries.remediation: Serve over HTTPS and add Strict-Transport-Security with an appropriate max-age.

entries.name: Cookie without HttpOnly / Secure / SameSite flag
tp_indicators: Session/authentication cookie readable by JavaScript or sent cross-site
entries.remediation: Set HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite on session cookies.
sources: OWASP WSTG v4.2 WSTG-SESS-02 Testing for Cookies Attributes
